body:
Every card in the Windows client (hand + revealed) shows its effect text permanently: 2x2 hand, 2x wrapped text with 1x fallback, no hover/click needed, effectless cards show no text, window 480x956, missing glyphs added. Verified via headless selftest frames; not run on Windows.

⚓ ☃
title: GUI: always-visible card effect text (31a598c, 68e5291, 3112bff)
